draw: 2026 limited quota elk and deer draws (nonresident elk Feb; deer and resident elk June)
choice_basis: 1st choice only. nr / nr_special: nonresident regular / special-price preference point draw (75% of each pool), rows [points, 1st-choice applicants, licenses issued] using the Issued column printed in the report; catch-all bottom rows ("< N" with 0 remaining quota or "<= N") are kept at points N-1 / N and pool everyone at or below. nr_frac / nr_special_frac: party-averaged fractional point levels printed as "< N" (between N-1 and N). nr_rand / nr_special_rand / res (and nr on cow/calf, doe/fawn hunts): random draws, single row [null, 1st-choice applicants, drawn]; random reports print no drawn counts, so drawn = min(random quota, 1st-choice applicants) (first choices are drawn before 2nd/3rd).

Wyoming doesn't publish who drew in the random draws, so those odds are estimated from the random quota and first-choice applicants.
